newsitem.title: USA: Lot outbound JFK cargo rises 26.7 percent in May.
newsitem.headline: Lot outbound JFK cargo rises 26.7 percent in May.

text.p: Lot Polish Airlines at New York's John F. Kennedy airport saw a 26.4 percent increase in outbound and an 8.8 percent increase in inbound traffic in May compared to year ago figures, Margaret Budnica, Cargo Sales Manager for the carrier at JFK, told Reuters.
The increase in JFK's inbound cargo traffic was far less than the rise in outbound as Lot extended its Newark services, Budnica said.
The carrier handled 163 tonnes of outbound cargo and 136 tonnes inbound during May compared with 129 tonnes of outbound and 125 tonnes of inbound cargo in May last year.
Shoes, assorted apparel, and eye glasses head the carrier's top imported commodity list.
Its export list is headed with electronic machinery, telephone equipment and passenger cars, Budnica said.
From New York flies two B767-200s and four B767-300s, one of which is on lease. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
